references.context: Then shoot the left-orbit forks to trap a ball.
references.label: Left-orbit forks and captive ball
references.description: The forks and captive ball are in the upper-left-middle area.

references.context: Shoot the flashing green center ramp to lock ball 2.
references.label: Center ramp lock
references.description: The center ramp rises through the upper-middle playfield.

references.context: Shoot the flashing green right orbit to start Brick Keeper Multiball.
references.label: Right orbit
references.description: The right orbit is the upper-right Brick Keeper start shot.

references.label: Wiseman drop and scoop
references.description: The Wiseman target and scoop are in the right-center area.

references.context: Shoot Helping Hands when the Friend Jackpot is ready.
references.label: Helping Hands scoop
references.description: Helping Hands is the left-center scoop.

references.context: After the eject, use the upper flipper to shoot the inner bridge loop.
references.label: Inner bridge loop
references.description: The bridge loop is above the upper flipper in the upper-left-center area.
